The calendar sets required school days and check-in times. Always-open school websites stay available on days off. Each child’s activity access is set in Daily Plan.

Weekly Spelling

Create each child’s weekly list, monitor daily practice, and prepare them for the separately graded test in their book.

Practice is safe.Daily mistakes never cost coins. Friday’s practice pre-test uses the gentle policy: +5 for 100%, +3 for 90–99%, no change for 80–89%, and below 80% loses one coin per missed word (maximum 5). It never enters the gradebook; the scanned book test is the actual grade.
Optional, per child

Personal Spelling Coach

When a child misses a practice word, BodeeGuard remembers the letter pattern and gives that child a short, specific tip the next time it returns. Tips are never shown during a practice pre-test.

Per-child learning memory

The built-in coach gives the first tip. When cloud AI is connected, only the spelling word, typed answer and miss count go to OpenAI to improve a later tip. The child’s name, grades and files are not included.

New Weekly Spelling List

Scan the printed pageYour chosen photo goes to OpenAI to propose spelling words. Review and correct every word before saving. BodeeGuard does not save the photo.
Use one word per line. Apostrophes and hyphens are supported; duplicates are removed when saved.

Learning / Vocabulary

Vocabulary Mastery

See what each child knows, what needs practice, and what’s ready for test day.

How mastery grows From first practice to lasting recall
01 · New

Meet the word and learn its meaning.

02 · Learning

Build understanding through practice and unaided recall.

03 · Test-ready

Check meaning, recall on two days, and three successful study days.

04 · Remembered

Recall after at least seven days without an assessed review.

Supplied contexts are checked separately. Original sentences are ungraded. A test date guides reviews; remembered words still return for spaced practice.

Poem Memorization

Assign exact poem text, watch line-by-line memory grow, and review a final recorded recitation.

Listen, practice, and review together.Children can hear the poem with a shared narration voice and practice a few lines each day. New narration uses your family AI allowance; saved audio is reused. Memory levels reflect their own practice answers; you review the final recitation.
